title: Symptom Entry Freshness
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=condition:symptom
| stats max(_time) as last_entry by journal
| eval hours_since_entry=round((now()-last_entry)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since_entry
description: Checks how current your symptom journaling is across each condition or journal track.
value: Health tracking loses value fast when entries become sporadic or backfilled from memory.
implementation: Capture a `journal` field on symptom logs and calculate hours since the latest entry.
visualization: Table of journals by hours since last symptom entry.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether you are still logging symptoms often enough for the record to stay useful.
